responsibility: Implements the TILE-Gx machine-description patterns for atomic and synchronization operations. It defines compare-and-swap, exchange, fetch-add/or/and/sub, and test-and-set expanders and insns, inserts pre/post memory-model barriers via tilegx_pre_atomic_barrier and tilegx_post_atomic_barrier, handles the CMPEXCH special register protocol, and lowers byte test-and-set onto aligned word-sized atomic fetch-or sequences.
